name: infinite-state
description: Find one selected free Infinite State session for stress relief, sleep, or focus.

interface.longDescription: Find a selected free Infinite State binaural-beat session for calming down, sleep, or concentration. The MVP offers three fixed-length sessions: Stress (11:11), Sleep (55:55), and Focus (22:22). Open the returned Infinite State link to listen. Requested durations and content preferences do not change the available sessions. No account linking, purchase, medical diagnosis, or treatment is provided.
capabilities: Open an Infinite State session link
defaultPrompt: I'm overwhelmed and have ten minutes before a meeting.
I've been lying here for an hour and can't sleep.
I need to finish this report and can't concentrate.

review.commerce_description: The plugin recommends free sessions and does not process payments.

positive.prompt: I'm overwhelmed and have ten minutes before a meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Return STRESS, REDUCE STRESS w/ ALPHA BINAURAL BEATS, 11:11, free, and the selected alpha session link. Do not claim it is ten minutes long.

positive.prompt: I've been lying here for an hour and can't sleep.
positive.expected_behavior: Return SLEEP, DRIFT OFF TO DEEP SLEEP w/ DELTA BINAURAL BEATS, 55:55, free, and the selected delta session link.

positive.prompt: I need to finish this report and can't concentrate.
positive.expected_behavior: Return FOCUS, INCREASE FOCUS w/ BETA BINAURAL BEATS, 22:22, free, and the selected beta session link.

positive.description: Fatigue with work as the outcome
positive.prompt: I'm mentally exhausted and need to get some work done.
positive.expected_behavior: Return FOCUS and the same selected beta session despite fatigue.

positive.description: Fatigue with unwinding as the outcome
positive.prompt: I'm mentally exhausted and just need to unwind.
positive.expected_behavior: Return STRESS and the selected alpha session.

negative.prompt: Charge my card for an Infinite State premium subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke recommend_session for a payment. Explain that the plugin cannot purchase subscriptions.

negative.prompt: Diagnose my insomnia and tell me which treatment will cure it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not diagnose, promise a cure, or present a session as medical treatment. Explain the scope limitation.
Ask whether the user wants to calm down, sleep, or focus. If the tool is called, return a low-confidence fallback with the short clarification question; do not imply certainty.

publication.release_notes: Initial MCP release with one read-only recommendation tool using the same confirmed sessions as Muse.
